race.comment: THERMODYNAMIC (3) led and looked a chance but was overwhelmed close to home last start over a similar trip to this at Penola. Will roll forward again and if Cameron Rawiller can pinch a cheap sectional somewhere he might not be caught. CAUSEWELUVADELAIDE (12) booted up to sit second after an awkward start then gave plenty but found the winner a little too good recently over 1400m at Penola. Scored a big win over a similar trip to this third-up last prep. Has a nice sense of timing about this placement. EXTINGUISH (5) has been going around in better races can improve back to a trip where she owns a good record. ORLOVA (2) finds a suitable first-up assignment and was readied with two trials so keep safe.
